transcription.xrdLocator: Cui et al. 2022 Table 3, PDF p. 9
transcription.visualCheck: Primary PDF abstract/rate units and Table 3 rendered locally and visually inspected on 30 October 2026.
transcription.nullMeaning: Printed dash, retained as unspecified; not imputed as zero or a measured absence.

assumptions: Density is an authored granite benchmark, not a measured density from the extracted run records.
Equivalent planar recession assumes geometric exposed area equals projected area and the selected rate persists; neither is a measured drilling speed or scale-up result.

Residue-mass fractions are chosen scenarios, not extracted yields. Treating reported XRD percentages as dry-solid mass fractions is an explicit conditional interpretation, not established by the selected table alone.
Phase inventory is a net stock. It does not separate primary-mineral dissolution from secondary formation of the same phase.
